text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthdaaay, El! As a fellow friend
who
dreams of captivating the world,
I've prepared
the finest of all presents
for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Behold, your gift... is a trip around the
world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ...But wait, Pearl! I love your gift,
but what
about my race tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry about a thing! Who said
you had
to travel to go on a trip around
the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Believe in your potential! Trust yourself!
Just
close your eyes and let your
imagination take
flight. Now, El... go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hear those crashing waves... Beautiful
beaches,
yachts sailing about... Yes,
we've arrived in
Auckland!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whoosh! A frigid wind blows in from the

overgrown beech forest... We're in a
fjord carved
out by an ancient glacier!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, the cute kiwis appear!
Tweet!
Tweet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Kiwis?! But... Wow, I really feel like I'm
in New
Zealand!
